# Where this task's containers come from

| part | source |
|---|---|
| agent container (`main`) | `environment/Dockerfile`: `compression_bench/platform-gguf:v1` plus the task's agent tools and starter; built by Harbor at run start |
| public Checker (`public-checker`) | `environment/public-checker/Dockerfile`: `compression_bench/platform-gguf:v1` plus the packaged evaluator and the **public** inputs; no network |
| hidden Verifier | `tests/Dockerfile`: `compression_bench/platform-gguf:v1` plus the packaged evaluator and the **hidden** inputs; no network; started host-side after the deadline |
| source model | the pinned BF16 checkpoint, bind-mounted read-only at `/input/model` (`COMPRESSION_BENCH_MODEL_DIR`) |
| submission | one host directory, `<run>/submission`: read-write in `main`, read-only in the Checker and Verifier |
| network | Harbor's egress-control sidecar: `main` reaches only the agent's model provider; the Checker and Verifier have none |
| GPU | one card (`COMPRESSION_BENCH_GPU_DEVICE`) shared by `main` and the Checker, then given to the Verifier |
| agent CLI | the host's `claude`/`codex` binary, mounted read-only at `/opt/compression_bench/bin`; credentials as one read-only file |

The evaluator modules in `environment/public-checker/` and `tests/` are byte
copies of `compression_bench/harness/final_validate/`; `evaluator-assets/task_policy.json`
is the only per-task evaluator input. `taskctl check` refuses a copy that drifts.

The single-copy lock: `main`'s PID 1 holds a shared flock on
`<run>/.submission.lock`; the Verifier's `test.sh` needs an exclusive one, so
it refuses to grade while any agent container can still write the submission.
